rule: A deployed version passes when, for each case, its answer carries the same facts as tool_output.

cases.question: Someone asks which project update stages are recorded as complete and whether progress summary, risk review or sending is next. Use the ProjectStatusNarrator tool on the sample.
cases.tool_output:
{
  "completed": [
    "Collect delivery signals"
  ],
  "external_work_performed": false,
  "next_stage": "Summarize progress",
  "project": "Contoso warehouse refresh",
  "scope": "Design-only checklist; no status narrative or message is generated.",
  "stages": [
    "Collect delivery signals",
    "Summarize progress",
    "Highlight risks",
    "Send update"
  ]
}
cases.local_answer:
Using the sample project, "Contoso warehouse refresh":

- **Recorded as complete:** Collect delivery signals
- **Next stage:** Summarize progress

So the progress summary is next, ahead of risk review (Highlight risks) and sending (Send update).

This is a design-only checklist. No status narrative or message was generated, and no external work was performed.
